children: BT Group plc (LSE:BT.A) reported first-half FY2027 revenue and adjusted EBITDA up 1% to £8.75 billion and £4.10 billion, respectively, while pre-tax profit rose 12% and free cash flow fell 59% to £0.2 billion. The company held its full-year guidance.
Previous Week Recap
Revenue Growth, Cash Flow Falls
: BT Group’s first-half FY2027 revenue and adjusted EBITDA each rose 1% to £8.75bn and £4.10bn; pre-tax profit gained 12%. Free cash flow fell 59% to £0.2bn. Full-year guidance held.
Quarterly Results Beat Consensus
: - BT Group plc (BT.A) reported second-quarter revenue of £4.428 billion, up 2% year on year, and adjusted core earnings of £2.084 billion, up 3%; both figures exceeded analyst consensus.
Pension Deficit Falls, Funding Improves
: BT.A’s pension deficit fell to £2.7bn in June 2026 from £3.7bn three years earlier. Funding rose to 92.3%; new measures target a £300m deficit and full funding by 2030.
£4bn Pension Scheme Security
: BT Group (BT.A) agreed to secure £4 billion for its pension scheme against EE shares until 2040. Additional pension contributions may apply if network asset sales exceed £2 billion.
Openreach Access Talks
: BT Group is discussing access to its Openreach network with Virgin Media O2, which has paused broad fibre expansion and plans to upgrade its cable network for 2Gbps service next year.
TalkTalk Acquisition Backed By Government
: BT Group plc (BT.A) agreed last month to buy rival TalkTalk after the company entered administration; the deal is backed by the government.
5G+ Coverage Reaches 81%
: BT Group (BT.A) lifted 5G+ population coverage to 81% from 73% in March. EE was named the UK’s best mobile network for a 13th straight year; BT’s full-fibre network also won top recognition.
Interim Dividend Raised To 2.50p
: BT Group (BT.A) raised its interim dividend to 2.50p per share from 2.45p. Payment is due 10 February 2027 to shareholders registered by 29 December 2026.
Verizon Joint Venture On Track
: BT Group plc (BT.A) said it remained on track to complete its joint venture with Verizon in the second half of calendar 2027.
